name: Поля й подвійний напад (2)
description:
In this lesson we take a little side trip. This time we won't attack a mating square but rather a promotion square! By the way, a promotion square can also be a checkmating square!

In the example we see that white gains material by attacking both a piece and a promotion square.

What do you have to do?

Win material by attacking a piece and a promotion square simultaneously.

examples.text:
The white pawn is close to promotion. If you have the chance, it is often advisable to play up your passed pawn as far as possible. Even here! After 1.d7! black has major problems. Not only does white threaten d8(Q)+, but also the knight 'hangs' on c8. Removing the knight gives white a queen thanks to the promotion. Defending the promotion square with 1...Ba5 costs Black a piece: 2.dxc8Q+.

Note that if the black pawn from h6 would have stood on h7, the promotion square is also a checkmating square!
